aliases: lambda equals h divided by p
de broglie wavelength equals planck constant divided by momentum magnitude
negative_phrases: lambda equals p divided by h
de broglie wavelength equals reduced planck constant divided by momentum magnitude
rows.scope_review: The numerator is Planck constant h, not reduced Planck constant. The denominator is the nonzero momentum magnitude; the wavelength is the spatial phase wavelength.

rows.scope_review: Preserve the maximum-energy subscript and subtract the work function from the photon energy. The threshold and single-photon conditions remain part of the source.

aliases: photon energy equals planck constant times frequency
negative_phrases: photon energy equals reduced planck constant times frequency
e equals h divided by f
rows.scope_review: Photon energy is Planck constant times ordinary frequency, not angular frequency with reduced Planck constant. The frequency and energy use the same frame.

aliases: sigma sub x times sigma sub p is greater than or equal to h bar divided by two
position standard deviation times the standard deviation of canonical momentum in the same direction is at least half the reduced planck constant
negative_phrases: sigma sub x times sigma sub p equals h bar divided by two

rows.scope_review: The product of standard deviations, not variances or measurement errors, is bounded below by half h bar. Equality is not asserted in general; the canonical momentum direction matches position.
